scientific_integrity: All thresholds are analytical. Finite numerical verification does not prove global oscillation, and classical Lotka-Volterra conservation is acknowledged as established.
scientific_limitations: The fixed exponential transmission rate diverges, and successive strict peaks shrink below any fixed detection threshold.
Applies to deterministic closed SIR with positive populations and 0<r<gamma; not to stochastic fade-out, imported infections, or periodic contact perturbations.
No independent scientific audit has been performed; specialized unindexed earlier treatments of incidence onset may exist.
title: An exact incidence-only oscillation window in exponential-transmission SIR
